primary_keyword: dating and social app retention benchmarks

facts.claim: Social apps retain a median 40% at day 1, 18% at day 7 and 12% at day 30, with strong performers at 50-60%, 25-30% and 15-20%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Social apps: strong performers 50-60% Day-1, 25-30% Day-7, 15-20% Day-30; medians 40%, 18% and 12%.

facts.claim: Across 31 app categories worldwide, 25.3% of users return on day 1 and average retention falls to 5.7% by day 30
facts.excerpt: Only 25.3% of mobile app users return on Day 1, with average retention falling to 5.7% by Day 30 across 31 app categories worldwide.

facts.claim: The average US App Store conversion rate across categories is 8.56%, with an average install rate of 3.8%
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: The average conversion rate across all categories on the US App Store was 8.56%, while the average install rate across all categories was 3.8%.

facts.claim: North America leads day-35 download-to-paid conversion at a 2.6% median, nearly twice India and South-East Asia at 1.4%
facts.excerpt: North America leads D35 conversion at 2.6% median, nearly 2x IN/SEA's 1.4%.

facts.claim: A three-day trial averages 26% cancellations against 51% for a thirty-day trial, and 31.1% of thirty-day trials cancel on day zero
facts.excerpt: A three day trial averages 26% cancellations; a 30 day one 51%. For 30-day trials, 31.1% cancel on day 0.

facts.claim: Quick-commerce platforms report 3x to 5x return on ad spend, while true return after commission and cost of goods runs 1.2x to 2.5x
facts.excerpt: Platform-reported RoAS ranges from 3x to 5x, but true RoAS after commission and cost of goods is 1.2x to 2.5x depending on the platform.
